definitions.regime: A/B/U only when the pointwise Wilson 95% lower bound exceeds 1/2; otherwise no resolved majority. No simultaneous coverage claim.
definitions.scope: Finite-time event outcomes, not stationary phases. Recovery trajectories remain in the denominator; no conditional median over B-only trajectories.
definitions.t_half_B: inf{t: number of confirmed B events by t / all trajectories >= 1/2}; null means not reached by T, not zero or infinite time.
definitions.verification: All COMPLETE and summary.json checksums verified against the frozen phase analysis; counts rechecked cellwise. Simulation trajectories are not rerun.

protocol.campaign_note: Dense finite-time fate map; stop at mathematically absorbing all-C recovery; final_state_time records actual snapshot time.
